reason: I buy plain black viscose at my local fabric shop, where I can hold it and see how it falls. I only order online when the shop doesn't have something, and plain black viscose isn't one of those things.
objection: I can't feel how heavy it is or how it drapes before I pay, and with viscose that's what decides whether a dress turns out right. A photo doesn't tell me if it's thin and see-through.
would_change_my_mind: If I could get a cheap sample swatch sent to my InPost locker first, or if my shop ran out of something I needed and they had it.
